description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes related to managing branches within a Git repository, including creating, tracking, validating, and removing branches.

methods.name: dwim_and_setup_tracking
methods.description: Sets tracking configuration for a branch based on the specified tracking mode.

methods.name: create_branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch in the repository with various options for starting point, tracking, and force.

methods.name: create_branches_recursively
methods.description: Creates a new branch in the repository and its submodules recursively, potentially from a specific commit.

methods.name: branch_checked_out
methods.description: Returns the worktree path if the branch is currently checked out.

methods.name: validate_branchname
methods.description: Validates if a name is a proper branch name and if the branch exists, returning info accordingly.

methods.name: validate_new_branchname
methods.description: Validates if a new branch name can be created, checking for conflicts and validity.

methods.name: remove_merge_branch_state
methods.description: Removes merge state information for the current branch.

methods.name: remove_branch_state
methods.description: Removes working state information for the current branch.

methods.name: install_branch_config
methods.description: Configures local branch tracking settings with upstream branches.

methods.name: read_branch_desc
methods.description: Reads the description for a branch.

methods.name: die_if_checked_out
methods.description: Checks if a branch is checked out in any worktree and aborts if so.
